task_completion.description: Survey created with correct title, IRB protocol, and PI name in the description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of Survey Summary or Edit Text elements showing Title: 'Social Media Usage and Community Belonging Study 2024', Description containing 'IRB Protocol #2024-SOC-0847' and 'Dr. Rebecca Thornton'.

task_completion.description: Welcome message contains consent keywords and end message contains contact/author info.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of 'Text elements' tab showing Welcome message with 'informed consent', 'voluntary', and 'anonymous'; End message with 'rthorn@stateuniv.edu' and 'Robert Putnam'.

task_completion.description: Survey configured for anonymity, no IP tracking, date stamps, data policy notice, and group-by-group format with progress bar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of 'Publication & access' or 'Notification & data' settings showing Anonymized responses: Yes, Date stamp: Yes, IP address: No. 'Presentation' settings showing Format: Group by group and Show progress bar: Yes. 'Data policy' notice enabled.

task_completion.description: Three specific question groups created with required questions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Survey structure tree showing groups: 'Informed Consent', 'Social Media Usage', and 'Community Belonging'. 'Informed Consent' group must show a question marked as 'Mandatory'. Other groups must contain at least one question.

task_completion.description: The survey is successfully activated and live.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Survey status indicator showing 'Active' (usually a green checkmark or 'This survey is currently active' message in the admin dashboard).

integrity.description: Agent used the LimeSurvey web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser navigating LimeSurvey menus, clicking buttons, and typing into web forms.

integrity.description: Agent manually entered the specific survey details rather than using a template or placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent typing or pasting the specific IRB protocol and PI details into the LimeSurvey text editors.

integrity.description: The survey was activated through the UI process, including the activation confirmation screens.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the 'Activate this survey' button being clicked and the resulting confirmation/warning screens.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be exactly 'Social Media Usage and Community Belonging Study 2024'. Required IRB Protocol: #2024-SOC-0847. PI: Dr. Rebecca Thornton. Welcome message must have: 'informed consent', 'voluntary', 'anonymous'. End message must have: 'rthorn@stateuniv.edu' and 'Robert Putnam'. Privacy settings: Anonymized=Yes, Date Stamp=Yes, Save IP=No, Data Policy=Visible. Presentation: Group-by-group with progress bar. Groups: 'Informed Consent' (mandatory question), 'Social Media Usage' (dummy question), 'Community Belonging' (dummy question).
